note: Known page-slug / data-slug divergences (RISK-018 / DC-05, Iteration 23 coordinator baseline). Each entry is a published non-ASCII entity name whose page slug (slugifyFolded, what /city/<slug> etc. actually serve) differs from its data-store slug (slugifyUnfolded, what /data/scores/<slug>.json is actually keyed by) because the row has no explicit pinned `slug` and the two conventions disagree on accent handling. This list is a ratchet: it may only shrink. A NEW name may only appear here as part of a deliberate, reviewed change (e.g. a newly published non-ASCII name) — never silently, and never as a side effect of `npm test` failing. Unifying the two conventions so this list goes to zero is the founder-gated migration RS-4b; do not resolve entries here by hand-patching slugs without going through that migration.
